results.title: Joe and the Giant Pumpkin
results.overview: Joe Adkins, a giant pumpkin growing veteran based in Wheaton, Illinois, embarks on a quest to grow his first 2,000-pound pumpkin.

results.title: Epitaph
results.overview: In Epitaph, filmmaker Cecilia Araneda returns to her long-estranged homeland, eco-processing 16 mm film with leaves and fruit gathered from her ancestral home, weaving a lament for her family’s past and the vanishing landscapes of home.  Filmed in both Chile and on the Tablelands in Canada, a site central to the modern understanding of plate tectonics, Epitaph incorporates eco-processed 16 mm footage, video, documents from public and private archives, and found footage to weave an epitaph to a home in the process of leaving the filmmaker, first as a result of exile and then to the gradual movement of time.  Epitaph has been eco-processed on-site in rural Chile at the site of the filmmaker’s father’s family using boldo, figs, fig leaves, walnut leaves, apples, apple leaves, fall grapes, fall grape leaves, olives, olive leaves, plums, mint, yard flowers and other vegetation.

results.title: The Plastic Country
results.overview: The new film from leading youth ocean and climate champion Kal Glanznig (Rising Up) is an eye-opening investigation of the impact of plastic on our bodies and ecosystems.

results.title: The Class: Online
results.overview: A group of college students reunite for a late-night online class after the events of The Class. What starts as a normal session begins to feel off when strange glitches and eerie occurrences appear on their screens.

results.title: Capturing Bigfoot
results.overview: On October 20, 1967, Roger Patterson captured 60 seconds of film showing a creature walking through the Northern California woods—footage that became the most analyzed and debated in history. Fifty-seven years later, a reel of 16mm film discovered in a safe changes everything, revealing the untold story behind the world's greatest mystery, told for the first time by Patterson's own son and the people who were there.

results.title: You can call me Skoi
results.overview: Tonsa, feeling invisible, joins Karn’s skoi gang seeking change. But her quest for recognition soon forces her to risk everything in a world she does not truly understand.

results.title: 7 anniversari
results.overview: Love blossoms between Teo and Emma, ​​two young people still finding their way in life. But Emma is afraid of commitment, and Teo has an idea and proposes a deal: their relationship will last exactly seven years. This way, from the beginning, they will both know when it's time to say goodbye, and Emma's fear of suffering will no longer exist.

results.title: 13 Alfinetes
results.overview: Miracles still happen—or so they say… What is the place of the sacred in the contemporary world?  Looking again at a myth that haunts us, that of Saint Anthony of Lisbon (and also of Padua), through the timeless painting of Goya, 13 Alfinetes is a story of love, revenge, and blood. It begins with a reenactment of an episode supposedly occurring in medieval Lisbon, filtered through the cosmopolitan 18th-century Madrid, and returning to Lisbon today, where miracles, in truth, no longer happen.

results.title: Between Us
results.overview: Marina and David, two young artists, no longer feel the same passion that they've had for one another upon the early stages of their relationship. As time goes on, tensions grow and it all reaches a powerful breaking point.

results.title: Georgia
results.overview: Famous Vegas director Steven Leroy receives a video link of the Kartvelian sword fighting dance from his daughter Mirrey. It impresses him so much that decides to travel to Sakartvelo in order to create an unforgettable show.

results.title: L'ora di tutti
results.overview: Set in 1480, the story revolves around the siege of Otranto, a pivotal port city in the Salento region, by the Ottoman Empire. It portrays the events of the battle that enabled the Turks to conquer this strategically important city.

results.title: I Don't Want to Drink Your Blood Anymore
results.original_title: I Don't Want to Drink Your Blood Anymore
results.overview: Eiko, a Japanese American teenage vampire, suffering from agoraphobia caused by the trauma from the night her family was murdered and she was turned, is unable and unwilling to leave her family’s home. And she not only loses track of time, but time itself. Eiko spends most of her years avoiding others and trying not to live life as a vampire, but the world won’t leave her alone.

results.title: Wilder Raids
results.overview: A family-friendly horse racing event in Wilder, Idaho last October turned into a nightmare when more than 200 heavily armed federal, state, and local law enforcement officers raided the mostly-Latino community event in military style, many in masks and without any identification.  Families were zip-tied at gunpoint, unlawfully detained, and denied water — including children — among other constitutional violations.

results.title: BLACK TRANS LIBERATION
results.overview: In New York City, a grassroots collective of Black trans organizers confronts homelessness, food insecurity, and inequity through mutual aid and radical joy.

results.title: Megan is Missing: Evil Never Dies
results.original_title: Megan is Missing: Evil Never Dies
results.overview: Megan Is Missing: Evil Never Dies takes place fifteen years after the original, with Michael Goi back writing and directing. Rachel Quinn and Amber Perkins play themselves, hunted by a man who believes they "should have died" in real life, and is out to get them.

results.title: Like Nothing Happened
results.overview: During Lao Yang’s quiet, lonely Spring Festival days, his beloved cat Tianjiu vanished from home.

results.title: Dear Isaac
results.overview: After being broken up with, River attempts to process her complex and conflicting feelings by writing letters addressed to her ex-boyfriend Isaac.
